candidate.mechanism: Set CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 in managed settings to reduce provider-credential exposure to hooks and MCP stdio subprocesses.
candidate.upstream_support: Claude Code changelog records the scrub control from 2.1.83, earlier than the pinned 2.1.233 release. Current docs describe stripping Anthropic/cloud-provider credentials from Bash, hooks and MCP stdio subprocess environments.

counterevidence.observed_upstream_reports: Current upstream Claude Code 2.1.x reports reproduce CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB forcing requested permission modes, including dontAsk, back to default; a July 2026 report reproduces this on 2.1.207. No current changelog evidence found in this review proves the interaction fixed by 2.1.233.
counterevidence.clayverse_consequence: ClayVerse intentionally launches interactive Claude with --permission-mode dontAsk and an explicit MCP-only allowedTools boundary. Silently forcing default could change unattended terminal semantics or introduce permission prompts/stalls.
counterevidence.existing_mitigation: ClayVerse already launches Claude under env -i with an explicit allowlist, so inherited service/container secrets are not admitted into the Claude parent environment by default. Missing subprocess scrub is therefore not evidence of a currently observed credential leak.

adjudication.reason: Do not trade an unverified compatibility regression for defense-in-depth without exact packaged Claude 2.1.233 execution.
adjudication.required_discriminator: In an actually-started authorized isolated exact-image environment, launch pinned Claude 2.1.233 with ClayVerse managed settings and verify both (a) hooks/MCP child credential scrubbing and (b) effective permission mode remains the intended fail-closed MCP-only behavior without unexpected prompts or mode downgrade.

duplicate_work_fusion.reason: Current main independently landed the command-pinned MCP authority regression plus remote-control lockout in commit a87bd8d0fd0bcdd48857714af3fc48ba85e1f2a7; retaining a second repair line would violate non-duplication law.

experiment_accounting.reason: Only minute-precision immutable trigger metadata is exposed for this user turn; the current atomic lease protocol forbids inventing whole-second identity.
